- All other candidates show different symptom patterns (leaf lesions, stalk rots, mosaic patterns) that don't match

The dark mass replacing the tassel on an otherwise green plant is the hallmark of **Head smut** (*Sporisorium reilianum*), where the pathogen colonizes the plant systemically and replaces the reproductive structures with dark masses of teliospores.
